entities.name: Clan Tree of Cridhe
entities.description: A magical oak at the center of Cridhe, as old as the plane, holding its primary leyline and controlling its seasons.

entities.name: Maker
entities.description: God who created the plane and carved the Blessing and Curse.

entities.name: Nohr
entities.description: Wizard who destroyed the tree trying to become a planeswalker; his line was cursed.

entities.name: Malvos
entities.description: Instigated Nohr's destruction of the tree.

entities.name: Aylith
entities.description: Keeper who broke the curse on Nazir.

entities.name: Nazir
entities.description: Descendant of Nohr whose curse was broken.

entities.name: The Parting
entities.description: The destruction of the tree and splitting of the isle.

entities.name: The Clan
entities.description: People separated when the isle split.

events.summary: Instigated by Malvos, Nohr destroys the tree; the isle splits and Nohr's line is cursed with madness.
events.quote: The isle split in two, separating the Clan.

events.summary: Aylith breaks the curse on Nazir and, together, they recreate the Clan Tree from the last acorn.
events.quote: Together, they spoke the litany of light and recreated the Clan Tree of Cridhe from the last existing acorn.

relations.note: Instigated his destruction of the tree.
relations.quote: Instigated by Malvos , the wizard Nohr destroyed the tree
The ancient curse of the god who created this plane became true.
